newsitem.title: FRANCE: Borotra - 30 pct of France Telecom to be sold.
newsitem.headline: Borotra - 30 pct of France Telecom to be sold.

text.p: French Industry Minister Franck Borotra said on Sunday the government would be selling 30 percent of France Telecom in its partial privatisation next month.

Speaking in an interview on Europe 1, Borotra also said an early French election, if called by President Jacques Chirac, would in no way affect the timetable of the planned initial public offering (IPO) in France Telecom.

Borotra said, "Today, the question is to know at what actual level the public offering will take place, which bears on 30 percent," reiterating that the state would keep more than 51 percent of the capital.
The government has already said it hopes to raise 30 to 50 billion francs from the sale of France Telecom capital. A price range for the IPO will be set on May 5.
A source close to the company said on Friday after consulting some 30 studies financial analysts valued the company at between 160 and 210 billion francs.
